sections.Profile:
"Harvest Time" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in August 1950. The game features two flippers, one pop bumper, and three kick-out holes. The artwork for this machine was created by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Native Americans, Original Theme
